title: Generator with a quit channel
prompt:
Write `SumOfSquares(c, quit chan int)`.

Send `1², 2², 3², …` on `c` until a value arrives on `quit`, then return. The consumer decides when to stop, and it may stop at any moment, even before reading anything.

A consumer that reads 5 values and then sends on `quit` sums them to `55`.
hint: Loop forever with a `select` that either sends the next square or receives from `quit` and returns.
